correctness.rationale: Equations (1) and (4) are exact polynomial identities. Lemma (2) treats zero, one or two active base edges exhaustively using max degree two and triangle-free incidence. It is sharp only for equal positive mass on an adjacent pair. The equality chain forces one positively signed vertical square. Exact rational tests verified 200 polynomial identities, 20 full sign enumerations, 87,369 positive-part path profiles and the equality witnesses. Computation is corroborative; universal proof is algebraic.

value.rationale: A motivated infinite class of Banach subspaces has an exact sharp embedding constant and full equality geometry.
